Brockbank and Carling AN ACT AMENDING SECTION 59-10-66, UTAH CODE AN-  NOTATED 1953; PROVIDING FOR WEEKLY DISBURSEMENT TO  LOCAL TAXING UNITS OF FUNDS RECEIVED OR COLLECTED BY  COUNTY TREASURERS; AND PROVIDING THAT COUNTY  72 SENATE JOURNAL Day 9 TREASURERS FAILING TO MAKE DISBURSEMENTS SHALL  FORFEIT THREE MONTHS’ SALARY; AND PROVIDING THAT  COUNTY COMMISSIONERS SHALL WITHHOLD COMPENSATION  TO TREASURER UPON NOTICE FROM LOCAL TAXING UNIT OF  NONCOMPLIANCE, was read the first time and referred to the Committee  on Rules. S. B. No. 64 By Messrs. Leavitt, Pettersson, Pugh, Jeffs, Ferry, Barlow, Bullen, Bischoff, Finlinson, Carling, Brockbank,  Clyde, Snow, Rees, Clark, Peterson, Jenkins, Warner, and Renstrom.
